headline: AzInTelecom Partners with Presight to Export SİMA Digital Signature Solutions
summary: Azerbaijan state enterprise AzInTelecom signed a memorandum of cooperation with Presight to support the international deployment of its SİMA biometric digital identity platform.
why: Digital identity platforms support digital banking, e-government solutions, and cross-border commercial verification.

impacts.name: AzInTelecom
impacts.why: International deployment partnership accelerates commercialization of digital signature technology.
